title: Every Back Road to My Heart

lines.plain: Here she comes, she knows where I park when the day's been hard
Cloud of dust, we keep driving till we don't see no cars
I'm on the other side of town tonight
But she can always find me when I'm lost
She speeds through all the grooves just like a needle on the record of my song
Ain't no hiding from her now
She knows every back road to my heart
I tried to run, leave it all behind like I always did
She won't let go, she won't give in, it's a fight I'll never win
She knows every bump, every curve I feel
When I'm lost and gone, she brings me home
She can read the road, got all my moods down
We ride those roads together, it ain't been bad so far
She knows every back road to my heart
Can't hide from her, she's in control
No mappin' out these open roads
That big old truck it never calls it quits
Sometimes she drives too fast, too slow, too steady
For this broken soul she finds me in, whatever state I'm in
Like a pack of wolves she'll fight like hell
Like an old hound dog she's on my trail
This here train is off his track, too far gone, there's no way back
Maybe way up in the hills, find a shortcut, yes she will
When I find I'm at my worst, I prayed to God but she got there first
She knows every back road to my heart
She knows when I'm wrong, she never says I'm right
But she knows when I'm broke down, she carries my spare parts
And I ain't got lost so far
She knows every back road to my heart

lines.comment: Bridge 2 — words from Benny; the demo runs out here.
